svg.title: Desktop authorization browser handoff
svg.desc: Proctor Desktop creates state, PKCE, a P-256 key, and an exact loopback callback before opening a hosted browser page. The browser binds the request, authenticates an account, and asks for approval. A one-use code returns to the exact callback. Desktop verifies state and exchanges the code with the same verifier and public key to create a Desktop Registration and DPoP Session.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: One approval, bound end to end

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The browser proves the person. Desktop retains the secrets that prove the client.
